text:
hana: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a minimal "smoke_metadata" block in descriptors to make intake->bench mapping auditable and cheap. Short notes.
hana: Why: reduce back-and-forth when teams expect fast signoff; require stable smoke inputs.
ravi: sketch?
hana: Example: 
```json
{
  "model_id":"org/phoenix:1.2",
  "smoke_metadata":{"seqlen_samples":[16,128,512],"warmup_iters":32,"smoke_token_cap":10000}
}
```
sara: Keep smoke_metadata mandatory but auto-gen allowed. Bench will annotate drafts with provenance.
bench-bot: [auto] when missing -> create draft /catalog/drafts/<model> and tag smoke_generated_by=bench-auto.
admit-bot: enforcement: smoke_profile present OR draft exists; otherwise block admission with actionable CLI: `redwood-admit validate --dry-run`.
ravi: Rollout: week0 optional+auto-gen; week4 require for new models. Action items: hana draft schema PR; ravi + bench team implement auto-gen and provenance stamps.
sara: +1, also add descriptor_version and descriptor_hash to bench outputs for triage.
hana: thanks, will start PR. :thumbsup:
